name: SEMICO
recent: Semico Capital 近期在 Berjaya Times Square 开设家庭娱乐中心，并持续进行董事及大股东股权变动。公司截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度营收环比下降 12.7%，但录得净利 337,000 令吉，净利率 4.2%。
notable: CEO Tai Lee Chuen 在闭市期间以每股 0.635 令吉购入合计 3,148,000 股。
MARC Experience Ventures 于 2026 年 10 月 22 日通过场外交易出售 34,000,000 股（9.444%），同日由 Tai Lee Chuen 购入。
公司在 Berjaya Times Square 开设家庭娱乐中心。
risks: CEO Tai Lee Chuen 在闭市期间转让合计 34,000,000 股至质押证券账户。
大股东 MARC Experience Ventures 于 2026 年 10 月 22 日通过场外交易减持 9.444% 股权。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度，营收为 8,032,000 令吉，环比下降 12.7%；净利为 337,000 令吉，净利率 4.2%，较上一季度的 -5.1% 有所改善。

recent_en: Semico Capital recently opened a family entertainment centre at Berjaya Times Square and continued to see changes in director and substantial shareholder interests. For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue fell 12.7% QoQ but the company recorded a net profit of MYR 337,000, a net margin of 4.2%.
notable_en: CEO Tai Lee Chuen acquired a total of 3,148,000 shares at MYR 0.635 per share during the closed period.
MARC Experience Ventures disposed of 34,000,000 shares (9.444%) via off-market transaction on 22 October 2026, which were acquired by Tai Lee Chuen on the same day.
The company opened a family entertainment centre at Berjaya Times Square.
risks_en: CEO Tai Lee Chuen transferred a total of 34,000,000 shares to pledged securities accounts during the closed period.
Substantial shareholder MARC Experience Ventures disposed of a 9.444% stake via off-market transaction on 22 October 2026.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 8,032,000, down 12.7% QoQ; net profit was MYR 337,000 with a net margin of 4.2%, improving from -5.1% in the previous quarter.
